source.title: The Meaning of the Days in the Maya Sacred Calendar
source.author: Komon Tohil K'iche' daykeepers of Zunil, Quetzaltenango, Guatemala
source.host: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian: Living Maya Time
source.source_direct_authority: Written by practitioners and reprinted with permission according to PDF footnote page 1.
source.consulted: Full three pages read in current research; no raw book PDF copied into GitHub.

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: E / Eb'
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: People born on this day are associated with travel inclination, generosity and sociability.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Frequency of voluntary exploratory travel when resources permit; could instead operationalize resource-sharing generosity, not both as a single score.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: blocked until correct day-name anchor, independent calendar parity, nonleading question, decoy control, source-frozen target

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: B’atz’ / Chuwen
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: A daykeeper tradition links this birth day to sociability, teaching roles and favorable work or relationship outcomes.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Repeated voluntary helping others learn; objective business/marriage results would require separate definitions and horizon.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: do not score high stakes claimed successes or after-the-fact interpretations

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: Aj / B’en
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: Birth-day disposition includes a calm manner alongside possible moodiness.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Measure calmness and mood variability separately to avoid posthoc fitting either polarity.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: source is broad; no scoring until operationalization and calibration

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: No’j / Kab’an
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: The source associates this day with prudence, advising/ideas and sometimes traditional occupations.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Specific cautious deliberation habits, not predicted profession from one arbitrary date sign.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: do not treat occupational stereotype as verified destiny

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: Imox / Imix’
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: The daykeepers describe associated birth dispositions using creativity and intuitive action language.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Repeated creative problem-solving behavior in concrete contexts; intuitive self-label should not be required.

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: Toj / Muluk
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: The source associates this sign with conciliatory roles and self-teaching.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Frequency of personally initiating conflict-mediation among peers (independent from general agreeableness).
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: not selected into prospective test until many-to-many overlap audit

observed_primary_claims_development_only.name: Tz’i’ / Ok
observed_primary_claims_development_only.source_claim_paraphrase: Traditional source ascribes both positive intelligence and negative jealousy stereotypes to births on this day.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.provisional_observable: Not selected for early self-report due stigma and broad, leading definitions.
observed_primary_claims_development_only.eligibility: no third-party personality attribution or relationship safety prediction

critical_limits: The source is living K'iche' testimony; Yucatec names are cross-reference but not identical universal regional interpretive rules.
The PDF describes day-name associations; do not infer fixed 13-tone modifiers without a separately sourced table.
Civil/Gregorian to sacred day conversion still needs source-anchored epoch, date/time boundary and policy checks.
The source describes broad positive and negative traits; prospective trial must declare outcome, comparison group and multiple-testing correction in advance.
Cultural source credibility is independent of empirical success; do not treat any claim as observed confirmed.
Do not put named birth data, privately authored survey answers or scanned copyrighted book pages into public GitHub.
